title: CompanyPracticeClaim payload
description: A technology, tool, method or standard a company uses in its own work, read from its own job adverts or careers pages (owner, 2026-10-17). Employer evidence: a person in that area of work there is likely to use it too, never proof that they do. Never anything about a person.

token.description: Lowercase token, as skills use it: react, node.js, salesforce, sap ariba, scrum.

area.description: The area of work it is used in (the groups of role families); company_wide when the page does not tie it to one team.
